text:
maria: starting rolling deploy v2.4 -> canary (rgw-canary). 10% traffic, canary-id: canary-2026-03-15-14. please watch latency and errors. will post status updates.

oncall-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT triggered: rgw.canary.slo_burn — p95_latency > 600ms & error_rate_5xx > 3% for service=rgw-canary (rule: slo_burn_canary_v1). Pager sent to #eng-oncall.

alex: seeing 502/504 spike on canary nodes. p95 at ~1.2s. sample logs showing downstream 502s. Trying to open the canary dashboard but the panel 404s (looks like the dashboard query uses old metric name). https://redwood.internal/d/rgw-canary

priya: alert looks noisy — rule is matching cluster label that we recently changed from cluster_name -> cluster. Both canary and a couple prod shards have that label so it's firing wide. :face_with_raised_eyebrow:

dan: good catch. i'm going to flip the kill-switch for the feature flag 'rgw_canary_v2' in canary only to stop traffic to the new path. will announce before flipping.

maria: ack. if kill-switch doesn't stop errors we'll rollback. no prod traffic currently on v2.4 (we routed 10% to canary), but want to reduce blast radius.

dan: running the flag toggle now:
```
$ rw feature-flag set rgw_canary_v2 false --env canary --who=dan
Flag 'rgw_canary_v2' -> OFF (canary)
```

oncall-bot: :white_check_mark: Feature flag updated: rgw_canary_v2=false (canary). Notifying traffic controller.

alex: traffic to v2 path dropped ~80%, errors dropping on some nodes, but a subset still shows elevated p95 and 502s. investigating. :eyes:

priya: i'm going to mute the noisy alert rule for 5m while we stabilize, so we don't drown the channel. muting only on canary namespace.

sre-rotation: taking over from here, oncall. I'll do a quick canary->rollback if the remaining nodes don't clear in 2 minutes. Handing off to @sre-rotation.

maria: handing off to @sre-rotation — i'm on product call but reachable.

sre-rotation: ack. looked at metrics: the problem is metric rename mismatch. dashboard queries for request.latency.p95 but the alert rule is still on latency.p95 (old). Some canary sidecars emit both, others only the new name so alerting went noisy AND dashboards returned 404 for the old panel.

alex: confirmed — here's a quick grep from the canary logs showing the new metric emission:
```
2026-03-15T14:24:12Z service=rgw-canary emit request.latency.p95=0.65
2026-03-15T14:24:12Z service=rgw-canary emit error.rate.5xx=0.04
```

sre-rotation: i'm going to rollback canary to v2.3 for safety. rolling at cluster-level.

sre-rotation: rollback command:
```
$ rw deploy rollback rgw-service --to-version v2.3 --scope canary --reason "canary SLO spike + metric rename causing noisy alerts"
```

oncall-bot: :gear: Deploy rollback initiated (id: rollback-8941). Watch logs at https://redwood.internal/deploys/rollback-8941

priya: unmuting alert rule but setting it to suppress canary label until after rollback complete. Will also follow up to fix rule selectors.

alex: after rollback p95 trending down to ~220ms and 5xx ~0.3%. Looks stable on all canary nodes now. No customer-facing errors observed in prod.

maria: big picture: no prod impact, canary only, traffic was limited to 10% and we hit the kill-switch + rollback within ~6 minutes of the spike. Good catch on labels.

sre-rotation: filing short incident note and action items. quick list:
- fix alert selector to use canonical metric name request.latency.* and restrict cluster label matching (priority P0)
- restore/fix canary dashboard panels that used old metric names (P1)
- add a small deploy checklist item to validate alert/dash queries after metric renames (P2)
- consider autosafety: block canary rollout if metric schema change detected in last 24h (investigate)

maria: agree. also add: make feature-flag kill-switch playbook clearer (where to toggle) and who to notify.

priya: adding the alert fix now. i'll open a PR referencing this thread.

sre-rotation: closing the pager — stability confirmed. Leaving minutes here for the follow-up. thanks folks. :thumbsup:
